name: Qingyun City
desc: A thriving great city with a dense population and bustling merchants, an important place for trading heavenly materials and earthly treasures and for seeking opportunities.

name: Shazhou City
desc: A small trade city in a desert oasis, where caravans pass through without end and cultivators gather for supplies and exchange.

name: Cuilin City
desc: A cultivation town deep in the forest; though less bustling than the famous capitals, it is still home to many cultivators and is ideal for cultivation and artifact refining.

name: Canglan City
desc: A flourishing great city at the river mouth, where waterways prosper and water-aspect cultivators gather in great numbers.

name: Lanyue City
desc: A small mountain city perched atop endless peaks, shrouded in mist year-round and rich in pure spiritual qi, an excellent place for ascetics to comprehend the Heavenly Dao.
